caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an iron trivet, illustrated in two perspectives: a side view at the top left and an angled, larger three-quarter view filling most of the lower right side. The trivet is composed of a teardrop-shaped flat plate with an openwork geometric design featuring circular and star-like patterns. The handle is elongated with an oval opening at its center, smoothly integrated with the main body. The design is rendered in shades of gray with fine shading to indicate texture and depth, and sits on a plain beige background. A straight ruler and a segmented scale in inches are included below the side view for measurement reference. The artist’s signature, "J. Sjaldoff," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
